item.title: Wispr Flow launches a Granola-styled meeting notetaker
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Wispr Flow's new terms of service indicate it will introduce a notetaker that generates meeting summaries and action items.

item.title: Elon Musk repeatedly one-upped his execs on SpaceX’s first earnings call
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: Musk kept inflating the already-big promises being made by SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen and Gwynne Shotwell on the company's first call.

item.title: Lucid’s turnaround plan hinges on $1.4B in cash savings, robotaxis
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec, Sean O'Kane
item.description: Lucid's new CEO Silvio Napoli listed four must-win priorities, including the successful launch of its midsize EV, finishing a factory in Saudi Arabia, cutting expenses, and robotaxis.

item.title: How to get the best hotel deals for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: We’ve partnered with hotels around Moscone West during Disrupt, taking place October 13 to 15, to secure the best prices available for attendees.

item.title: SpaceX has bought $329M worth of Tesla Megapacks so far this year
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: The purchase illustrates just how interconnected Elon Musk's universe of companies are.

item.title: SpaceX doubles revenue on Anthropic and Google compute deals, Starlink growth
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: SpaceX doubled its revenue compared to last year, according to its first quarterly earnings since going public in June.

item.title: Android app developers may be unwittingly sharing their users’ location data with advertisers
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: New findings by the Electronic Frontier Foundation aim to warn app developers that some of the third-party code they place in their apps may also collect their users' location data when they grant permission to the app.

item.title: Open-weight AI models are catching up to the frontier. The safety gap remains.
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: A new SaferAI report finds Z.ai's open-weight GLM-5.2 approaches frontier AI capabilities while lacking key safety mitigations, renewing concerns that powerful open models could outpace governance and safeguards.

item.title: Anthropic signs $10B deal with AI cloud startup Volta
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Anthropic has been on a cloud partnership spree in recent months, and its latest move is reportedly a $10 billion deal with AI cloud startup Volta.

item.title: Meet Wrinkles, an app that uncovers the hidden stories of the places around you
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: Wrinkles, available on both iOS and Android, essentially acts as an AI-powered audio tour guide that reveals hidden history and local stories.

item.title: Nvidia doesn’t mess around: A week after open AI industry group formed, it’s already showing progress
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: The week-old Open Secure AI Alliance, spearheaded by Nvidia and grown to over 120 companies, already has proposals out for defending against AI agents.

item.title: Waymo opens up robotaxi service in Dallas to everyone
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Waymo has dropped the waitlist for its robotaxi service in Dallas, the latest step in the company's bid to scale its self-driving technology across the United States, U.K., and Europe.

item.title: Take an extra $100 off your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass: This week only!
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Starting today, you can take an additional $100 off your founder, investor, or attendee TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass, which is a nice bonus on top of our current discounted pricing.

item.title: TV Time co-founder launches Bingers to revive the beloved TV-tracking app
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Bingers is a new TV and movie tracker that revives the social features fans loved with TV Time, while adding support for importing their viewing history.

item.title: Hackers steal over $130M by exploiting bug in offline hardware wallets
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
item.description: A security vulnerability in the cryptocurrency hardware wallet Coldcard is allowing hackers to drain the crypto from victims’ wallets. The total losses amount to more than $130 million, according to blockchain-monitoring firms.

item.title: Spotify expands AI remix and covers project with Merlin partnership
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Spotify says Merlin, which represents more than 30,000 independent labels and distributors, has joined Universal Music Group in backing its upcoming AI-powered remix and covers product. The paid tool will let fans create AI-generated covers and remixes of participating artists’ music while ensuring artists opt in, receive credit, and are compensated.

item.title: Texas halts new data centers as governor calls for audits
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Tech companies and developers have been scouring the U.S. for places to build data centers, and they’ve been drawn to Texas’ loose regulations and seemingly abundant power supply. But even Texas can be pushed to the brink.

item.title: Walmart completes its acquisition of TV advertising company Vibe.co
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The acquisition, which was announced in June, brings Vibe.co into Walmart Connect, Walmart's connected TV advertising platform.

item.title: Elon Musk spends half his time talking robots and AI on Tesla earnings calls
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane, Russell Brandom
item.description: An analysis of the last seven years of Tesla earnings calls shows just how little attention Musk pays to Tesla's car business.

item.title: Host a Side Event during TechCrunch Founder Summit Week in Boston
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Want to tap into the energy of 1,100+ startup founders, investors, and tech leaders descending on Boston for the Founder Summit 2026 on June 9? Host your own Side Event during “Founder Summit Week,” happening June 4-10!
